title: The Stars Are Warning Aries
script_text: Stop! Aries, the stars are screaming at you right now. Mars, your ruling fire planet, forms a tense square to Saturn sitting heavy in your 12th House of Secrets, creating real friction between your drive and hidden obstacles you can't yet see — but you'll feel it strongly. Transiting Venus glides into your 7th House of Partnerships, pulling someone magnetic toward you. If single, embrace this opening. If taken, an old connection may quietly test your loyalty. The Sun blazing through your 10th House of Career gives you real leverage for that pitch or presentation. Decision-makers are noticing your power move this week. Avoid workplace gossip — Neptune's fog in your 12th House is clouding who you can truly trust. An unexpected financial bonus could surface by Friday if you've been patient. Subscribe so you don't miss what's coming for Aries this week.
